submitted_sql: SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS track_revenue FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' AND g.name = 'Rock';
